question.text: An LP DDQ includes: 'Describe any qualified audit opinions received by the Firm's portfolio investments during the Firm's period of ownership.' The Manager's BEST-practice response should cover:

answer.text: A full list with explanation of nature of qualification, resolution steps and current audit status — since a qualified opinion is a classic ODD red flag.
A polite refusal — portfolio company audit data is confidential under the NDA.
Aggregate statistics only, no individual portfolio company names.
Only qualifications materially impacting fund NAV (minor qualifications can be excluded).

explanation.text: The Logic: Annexure 12.1 (page 335) asks the manager to describe qualified audit opinions received by portfolio investments during the period of ownership and to provide the latest audit reports. Disclosure is the source-backed response, with the latest audit reports made available alongside the description. The Trap: Options B, C and D all withhold information the Annexure 12.1 question expects to be disclosed. Note: Per Annexure 12.1 (p.335), the DDQ expects the manager to describe any qualified audit opinions on portfolio companies during ownership and to provide the latest audit reports — full disclosure is the source-backed response.
